subject: info-dy
title: INFO.DY.------C.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 170 (UPB(II)-32). INFO-DY is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: MT-INFO (multi-information), AFL (affinity alignment) and SOC-RT (social reality). From AFL: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From SOC-RT: POL-P (political policies). From POL-P: IST-ACT (isolated activism) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From IST-ACT: DEF (definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and TRS (transition). From ALT-F: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics).
